page.layout: One printed page, text block in one column, with a marginal note "Epilogus." in the right margin beside the paragraph "Atque hæc". Running head at top left and top centre, page number top right. Below the text, a gathering signature "Fff". The strip of text at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: obtinet dominium, quiq; magistratum alia conditione gladio non accinxit, quàm ut ad ipsius iussum illum stringat, tanquam ipsius minister, quemadmodum & legum Dd. magistratum legum vocant ministrum.C.de legibus l.digna vox, Theodosius & Valent.dicunt:Digna vox est majestate regnantis, legibus se alligatum principem profiteri: adeò de authoritate juris nostra pendet authoritas, & revera majus imperio est, submittere legibus principatu. Quā-tò magis digna vox est majestate cujuscunque magistratus, legibus divinis immutabilibus, quæ fundamentum in jure naturæ & Decalogi habent, alligatum se, & subjectum profiteri. Per me enim, inquit sapientia, reges regnant, & principes decernunt justitiam. Prov.8.v.15.

Atque hæc, cùm exercendi mei ipsius causâ,Epilogus. tum in gratiam, non illorum tantùm, qui hoc officii à me requisiverunt, sed aliorum quoque, quibus hæc usui esse forte poterunt, in lucem dare voluit, de quæstione, variè hac tempestate vexatâ atque agitatâ, an, & quatenus forenses Mosaicæ leges in novo Testamento abolitæ & antiquatæ sint, deque præterea legum harum, juxta præceptorum Decalogi, cujus appendices sunt, seriem speciali examinatione atque explanatione, ex quâ, duplici lumine, naturæ videlicet & gratiæ, adhibito, de quæstione hac in thesi generali judicium informari potest rectiùs & certiùs, quæ-nam ex his juris universalis aut particularis, perpetui aut temporanei, immutabiliaque adeò aut mutabilia sint; in quibus ipsa legum harum speciès maneat, aut ubi genus aliquod erui qpor-[?]

page.notes: The left-edge strip of marginal text belongs to the neighbouring page and was left out. The word at the line end "qpor-" is unclear; the continuation is doubtful. The abbreviation "quiq;" is as printed. "Quā-" with a macron is doubtful. The printed "Epilogus." note is in the right margin beside "causâ,".
